title: What if MIT and Stanford swapped locations?
narrator: Deadpan documentary: calm and dry, treats the impossible premise like a serious report. The jokes land through understatement.
logline: MIT gets 8,353 acres of room and no idea what to do with it. Stanford gets squeezed onto Mass Ave and meets snow.
